From Diver Down · Price: the stand has to dive into an object first, and the blow only lands when someone touches it.

Theme Space

  • 1: 2 actions: your stand dives into an object or surface and stores one Strike for up to 1 hour. The next creature that touches it takes the Strike's damage (no attack roll needed; @Check[reflex|against:stand|basic]{basic Reflex} for half).
  • 5: The stored blow can be released from up to 10 ft through the object instead.
  • 9: Surge: store @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[force]] damage instead of a Strike.
  • 13: Store two blows in two objects.
  • 17: A creature hit by a stored blow is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{immobilized} by the object's shape for 1 round (@Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude} negates).

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
